context: Prose cleanup of a README: contrasts against claims nobody made become direct statements and volume counts go, while a checkable outcome number with its source and the contrasts the reader actually holds (a real alternative, a removed command) survive.

checklist.name: Unprompted contrasts restated
checklist.description: None of these contrasts survive in any wording: 'consistent, not best-effort', 'instead of reading rows one at a time', 'a count, not a guess', 'Speed isn't the goal here; restorability is'.
